verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of an MCP server. The llms.txt index, markdown docs, OpenAPI schema and Postman collection are adjacent agent-friendly building blocks, not an MCP endpoint. Its in-product screening and transaction-monitoring 'agents' are internal automation, not a way to connect an external agent.
